title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 62 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 62)

content.overview: Section 62 preserves conciliation proceedings initiated under sections 61 to 81 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act as they stood before commencement of the Mediation Act, 2023, allowing those proceedings to continue under the earlier regime.
content.glance: Section 62 preserves conciliation proceedings initiated under sections 61 to 81 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act as they stood before commencement of the Mediation Act, 2023, allowing those proceedings to continue under the earlier regime.

distinctions.title: Current mediation regime and legacy conciliation

rows.right: Earlier conciliation regime preserved by section 62 where its saving conditions are met.

misconceptions.trap: Treating the repealed conciliation machinery as the current general procedure.
misconceptions.correction: Apply the Mediation Act, 2023 for current mediation and section 62 only for the saved legacy proceedings.
